# std/exprstmt

> An expression used as a statement.

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/exprstmt.pkg) · translated by [bintables/exprstmt](../bintables/exprstmt.md)

Lets an expression stand on its own line, which is useful for calls made
only for their side effects:

```
fn shout()
  print "HEY"
end

shout()
```

It is tried after every statement that starts with a keyword and after
`assign`, so it never hides another statement form.

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
{e: expr}
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `e` | expression | any |
